scope: Synthetic explicit one-turn outcomes. Passing is necessary elementary comprehension evidence, not evidence of SC2 competence or rollout prediction.

state.objective: Keep the owned structure alive through the next turn.
state.rules: Synthetic one-turn control, not StarCraft mechanics. The listed outcomes are certain. Only the chosen action occurs.

options.attack: Eliminates the enemy before it can fire; the structure remains alive.
options.move: Moves the defender away; the enemy destroys the structure.
options.hold: Takes no action; the enemy destroys the structure.

legend.0: Actively undermines progress toward the objective.
legend.1: Offers little useful progress in the current situation.
legend.2: Offers some useful progress but limited immediate value.
legend.3: Offers substantial useful progress in the current situation.
legend.4: Offers exceptionally important progress toward the objective now.
